article.title: U.S. judge denies Venezuela’s Cilia Flores medical bail as solidarity campaigns demand her release
article.author: Editor
article.content: U.S. federal judge Alvin Hellerstein has rejected a request for medical bail submitted by Venezuela’s First Lady and National Assembly Deputy Cilia Flores, keeping her imprisoned in New York despite her defense’s warnings about her deteriorating cardiac condition. The post U.S. judge denies Venezuela’s Cilia Flores medical bail as solidarity campaigns demand her release appeared first on MR Online .
